FN-XV4P7E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 45
Committee: Children and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Jeremy Gray
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/21/2023
House Bill 45 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama State
Board of Education to adopt guidelines and develop an information sheet regarding cardiac
arrest symptoms and warning signs. Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative
obligations of the local boards of education to establish the minimum penalties, provided by this
bill, for coaches that fail to follow procedures or complete training required by this bill.
